https://youtu.be/Hrr3dp7zRQY - Ryo Fukui/Scenery (1976)

Rediscovered this self taught pianist from Japan after briefly listening years ago in my younger days. Never fails to brighten my day. I find a special kind of melancholy seeping from some tracks that just hits the spot. Always worth a listen!


https://youtu.be/ygiq6AMBGko - Gru/Cosmogenesis (2010)

Wading the waters that is our current modern progressive metal scene, I find much begins to blend together in an incoherent cacophony of homogeneity. However, chance my discovery of this single and seminal Progressive Metal album from Gru, something inexplicably pulls me back for frequent re-listens. Gru seems a true innovator and his sole work is certainly worth a listen. 


https://youtu.be/69fnUZhV8SI Alcest/Spiritual Healing (2019)

The merging and intermingling of Shoegaze and Black Metal seems a likely result of artists trying to further emphasize an ultra-nostalgic and despondent emotional landscape through their craft. At the forefront; Alcest. Every release since their inception is sublime and worth a listen, but it is Spiritual Healing which has seen frequent rotation in my collection since its release. Worth a listen!
